subject.title: feat(exec): expose knownLongFlags in safeBinProfiles config schema

question: Should `knownLongFlags` become a public `tools.exec.safeBinProfiles.<bin>` operator config field for custom safe-bin GNU abbreviation behavior with the current denied-prefix filtering semantics?
rationale: The patch is mechanically focused, but this is a new exec approval/security-boundary config surface, and repository policy requires maintainer intent before accepting such public operator controls.

options.title: Accept the field after repair
options.body: Land this design after the docs formatter/rebase are fixed, treating `knownLongFlags` as the public custom-profile knob for no-value known long flags.

options.title: Keep the field internal
options.body: Close or redirect this PR if maintainers do not want validator metadata exposed as public config and prefer a different safe-bin profile model.

options.title: Narrow to another config shape
options.body: Ask for a revised PR only if maintainers prefer a higher-level operator field such as explicit boolean flag allowlisting instead of `knownLongFlags`.

recommendation.title: Accept the field after repair
recommendation.body: Land this design after the docs formatter/rebase are fixed, treating `knownLongFlags` as the public custom-profile knob for no-value known long flags.

likelyOwner.reason: The commit history shows the strongest ownership signal on safe-bin policy modules and docs touched by this PR.
